selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall policy and SSH allowance
selected_evidence.summary: Firewalld is active and enabled; SSH is allowed; permanent and runtime rules accept node2 on TCP/9000 before catch-all IPv4/IPv6 reject rules.

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP/9000 allowed from node2 and rejected from node3/everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: Direct tests against a live node1 listener show HTTP 200 from node2 and immediate rejection from node3, both before and after node1’s restart.
Both peer nodes received node1’s OpenSSH banner; node3’s check was repeated after its restart.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, full system/service recovery, persistent rules, and recovered allow/reject behavior.
Shows healthy baseline and permitted path, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered sshd, and restored access to node1:9000.
Shows healthy baseline and rejected path, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered sshd, continued TCP/9000 rejection, and SSH reachability.
